allowances.rationale: Historical enum-to-string macro compares unsigned enum values against zero.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the vendor macro snapshot is replaced or its enum range check is corrected.

allowances.rationale: The pinned test library compares assertion operands with different signedness.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when ArduinoUnit is replaced or provides warning-free mixed-type comparisons.

allowances.rationale: The pinned test library uses two variable-length buffers for flash-string comparison.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned library replaces its variable-length comparison buffers.

allowances.rationale: Pinned binutils 2.26.2 reports the unchanged four-byte data alignment with the historical linker script and vendor archives.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove after a separately reviewed linker or vendor ABI change eliminates this exact alignment diagnostic.

allowances.rationale: The frozen codec implementation does not consume every generic audio-driver argument.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when this content-pinned codec snapshot is maintained or replaced.

allowances.rationale: The frozen codec initialization retains unused generic device-selection locals.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when this content-pinned codec snapshot is maintained or replaced.

allowances.rationale: Historical codec initialization omits its return value; the baseline caller ignores it. Adding a return changes linked firmware and requires separate behavior review.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove after reviewing codec status propagation and accepting a new firmware baseline.

allowances.rationale: The frozen discovery audio callbacks and board hooks retain generic interface parameters.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the content-pinned board audio snapshot is maintained or replaced.

allowances.rationale: The frozen output MSP setup retains an unused receive-DMA handle.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the content-pinned board audio snapshot is maintained or replaced.

allowances.rationale: The frozen transfer wrapper records but does not propagate the HAL status.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove after a separate audio error-propagation review of this pinned snapshot.

allowances.rationale: The historical stop wrapper omits a return value; preserve the frozen driver pending audio status review.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove after reviewing and specifying stop-status propagation for this snapshot.

allowances.rationale: The frozen I2C error hook does not consume its address argument.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the content-pinned peripheral snapshot is maintained or replaced.

allowances.rationale: The frozen peripheral implementation retains an unused external-I2C handle.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the content-pinned peripheral snapshot is maintained or replaced.

allowances.rationale: The frozen discovery peripheral snapshot retains its unused I2C readiness helper.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove when the content-pinned peripheral snapshot is maintained or replaced.
